question: Who among the following has been appointed as the 26th Governor of Reserve Bank of India in December 2024?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sanjay Malhotra** was appointed as the **26th Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in December 2024.
 
• He succeeded the previous RBI Governor to take charge of India's **central banking institution**.
